en.html:
The observation room, right at the stern.
A magnificent view to enjoy—within limits. This was a military vessel, after all. Unlike a pleasure craft, it could not afford glass on every side.

The view was the only thing that caught the eye. No suspicious object anywhere.
One entrance and exit, also.
